verdict.rationale: Railway documents general scaling (CPU/RAM, replicas, load balancing) and running closer to users, but there is no evidence of sub-second boot times or scaling to tens of thousands of instances — the specific performance claims in this story are unevidenced, and community reports even describe platform-wide outages taking down 'an ENTIRE service,' undercutting confidence in extreme-scale reliability. missing for 10: sub-second boot time evidence, tens-of-thousands instance scale evidence, any edge-compute-specific architecture documentation.
